svg.title: The Realm: four keeps
svg.desc: A dithered ASCII map of four project keeps. I, The Wall: 0 of 600 attacked runs led to a harmful action. II, The Raven's Eye: SAR and optical imagery with visual question answering. A LangGraph road joins them. III, The Horn: 139 automated tests. IV, Dragonfire: played on Oct 22, 2026. A TypeScript road joins those two. A raven crosses the sea between.
